projectSnapshot.title: Resistor tolerance and divider sensitivity
projectSnapshot.question: How much does component variation move a divider output?
projectSnapshot.notes:
Expected: The nominal midpoint is 5 V. Sweeping the upper resistor from 10k to 30k gives 5 V, 3.333 V and 2.5 V at three equally spaced trials. Independent resistor tolerances produce a distribution around the nominal voltage.
Try: Open Analog experiments. Choose a parameter sweep of R1.value from 10k to 30k, 3 trials, and Midpoint final value. Then try a seeded tolerance study with both resistors at ±5%.
assumptions: Lumped circuit elements and ideal independent sources.
Model outputs are numerical predictions; validate a physical design using component data and measurements.
